🎬 Fresh (2022) — Thriller, Horror
Fresh (2022) follows Noa, a young woman who becomes frustrated with modern dating and the difficulty of finding someone she can genuinely trust. When she meets Steve, a charming and seemingly ideal man, she believes she may have finally found a connection worth pursuing.
However, what begins as an exciting new relationship gradually turns into something far more disturbing. Noa soon realizes that the person she trusted is hiding a horrifying secret, forcing her to rely on her instincts and determination to survive.
The film explores themes of trust, manipulation, modern dating, loneliness, and the dangers of judging people solely by their appearance. Its unsettling story also uses dark humor to examine how easily charm and confidence can disguise dangerous intentions.
More than just a horror thriller, Fresh is a sharp and disturbing look at trust, relationships, and recognizing when something isn't what it seems. 🔥
💬 How quickly do you think you can tell when someone isn't who they appear to be? 👇

source_details.synopsis: Fresh is a 2022 American horror thriller film directed by Mimi Cave, in her directorial debut, from a screenplay by Lauryn Kahn. The film stars Daisy Edgar-Jones and Sebastian Stan. It is a co-production between Legendary Pictures and Hyperobject Industries; Adam McKay produced the film alongside Kevin J. Messick. Fresh had its world premiere at the Sundance Film Festival on January 20, 2022, and was released on March 4, 2022, via Hulu by Searchlight Pictures in the United States and Disney+ via Star internationally, marking the first Legendary film released by Disney rather than Warner Bros. Pictures, Universal Pictures or Netflix. The film received generally positive reviews from critics.
